Perturbation sensitivity measures reliance on an input; it does not establish that a corresponding training intervention improves generalization. Sequential-recommendation research compares original and shuffled histories to assess dependence on order, finding that some datasets provide weak evidence of sequential structure ([Klenitskiy et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.12008)). Proposed design: preregister diagnostic-to-intervention predictions, measure diagnostics using training histories only, then compare each intervention against the corrected HSTU baseline under identical seeds and training budgets. Include matched control interventions. Evaluate whether diagnostic magnitude predicts the direction and size of validation gains; four category-level observations alone provide weak evidence of predictive validity.

Sampled HR@10 needs narrow interpretation: sampled ranking metrics can reverse full-catalog model comparisons, even in expectation ([Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Preserve the benchmark’s fixed users and 99 negatives for paired comparisons. Proposed uncertainty analysis: resample users within each category, retaining baseline/intervention hit outcomes together, then recompute the four-category macro-average difference. Report category effects and paired bootstrap intervals. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the fixed candidates and trained models; they do not capture negative-sampling variability or establish full-catalog recommendation quality.

Repeatedly choosing interventions or checkpoints using the same validation scores creates adaptive overfitting; ordinary confidence intervals do not correct selection bias ([Dwork et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629)). Limit and record hypotheses and validation queries, specify decision rules before comparison, and report attempted interventions rather than only winners. Keep the host’s held-out evaluation untouched until final selection. Treat diagnostic-guided gains during search as exploratory evidence, with confirmation supplied by the independently evaluated final model.
